item.text: [{"task_id":"e99362f0","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    separator, background, step = [int(round(v)) for v in params['layout']]","    priorities = [int(round(v)) for v in params['priorities']]","    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if np.all(row == separator)]","    cols = [i for i, col in enumerate(grid.T) if np.all(col == separator)]","    if not rows or not cols:","        return grid.copy()","    r = rows[0]","    c = cols[0]","    panels = [grid[:r, :c], grid[:r, c + step:], grid[r + step:, :c], grid[r + step:, c + step:]]","    out = np.full(panels[0].shape, background)","    for color in priorities:","        for panel in panels:","            if panel.shape != out.shape:","                return grid.copy()","            out = np.where(panel == color, color, out)","    return out.astype(int)"],"shapes":{"layout":[3],"priorities":[4]},"params":{"layout":[4,0,1],"priorities":[2,9,7,8]},"rationale":"Overlay the four panels separated by color 4, preserving their orientation. Resolve overlaps with priority 8 > 7 > 9 > 2; uncovered cells remain 0. This reproduces all six demonstrations."}]
